exercises.why: **относи́тельно** — relatively (proportionally). Source: Wiktionary, «-о» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-о#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**положи́тельно** — positively (in various senses). Source: Wiktionary, «-о» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-о#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ви́димо — apparently, evidently; ми́рно — peacefully; относи́тельно — relatively (proportionally); положи́тельно — positively (in various senses).
**мы́сленно** — mentally (in a mental manner). Source: Wiktionary, «-о» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-о#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**бо́йко** — briskly. Source: Wiktionary, «-о» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-о#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**оживлённо** — in a lively manner, vibrantly, vividly. Source: Wiktionary, «-о» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-о#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**безусло́вно** — certainly, undoubtedly, absolutely. Source: Wiktionary, «-о» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-о#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
